_purpose: Reusable source-level expensive computation reused by multiple candidates
_design_principle: ONE SOURCE -> expensive analysis once -> MANY candidates reuse it
_not_forced: Candidate-dependent computation is NOT forced into source-level caching

source_identity.identity_note: Stable per file; same source = same hash

performance_notes.framing_optimization: Reusable CV computations (tracking, Re-ID embeddings, scene cuts) moved to source-level artifact. Per-candidate crop selection remains candidate-level.
performance_notes.smart_pacing_optimization: No meaningful remaining optimization — already bounded and fast. Source-level silence signals could be reused but gain is minimal.
performance_notes.panns_inference: Real CNN14 inference verified. Current source produces 0 events at threshold 0.5. Calibration exists (0.5->0, 0.25->1, 0.15->6, 0.10->15). Threshold NOT lowered artificially.
performance_notes.panns_hook_score_contribution: Capped and advisory; does not override deterministic pipeline.

accepted_limitations: VLM quality evaluation is manual and advisory; not a release gate for clips.
PANNs negative result (0 events) is a valid genuine result, not a failure.
Framing remains expensive; only reusable CV moved to source-level.
